policies.value: Use an LLM judge with each fact's judge_prompt. Do not flatten judgment guidance into literal substring lists.
Only READY_FOR_JUDGE facts may contribute to accuracy. REVIEW_REQUIRED facts remain visible but unscored.
Any fact containing public preview must be re-verified at least quarterly.
Comparison prompts are intentionally evaluated by comparison win-rate logic. Missing product-fact coverage on those prompts is not an accuracy gap.
Do not create facts for dollar amounts, current version numbers, SLA percentages, performance or benchmark numbers, or unapproved customer metrics.
This v2 fact base is not consumed by the current literal-matching scorer. Activate it only with the separate LLM-judge implementation and regression tests.
